cohort: 34 fetuses suspected of having CPAM referred to a single fetal-maternal tertiary center for lung disease between October 2003 and September 2016.
finding: Antenatally diagnosed CPAM have an excellent prognosis, and invasive prenatal thoracoamniotic shunting is proposed in rare cases with unequivocal fetal compromise.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis: 22 weeks (range 21 to 28)
